aarti.tek: Perform the āratī of Hanumān, the darling son (of Añjanā), crusher of the wicked, a portion of Śrī Rāma's own power.
aarti.pad1: By his strength the great mountains tremble; disease and fault dare not come near him. Añjanā's son is the giver of great strength, the lord who ever helps the saints. ।।1।।
aarti.pad2: Śrī Rāma gave him the betel roll of the task and sent him; he burnt Laṅkā and brought news of Sītā. Laṅkā had a fortress and a moat like the ocean, yet the son of the Wind went without delay. ।।2।।
aarti.pad3: He burnt Laṅkā, slew the demons and accomplished the tasks of Sītā and Rāma. When Lakṣmaṇa lay unconscious, he brought the life-restoring herb before daybreak and saved his life. ।।3।।
aarti.pad4: Entering the netherworld and breaking through Yama-like guards, he tore off Ahirāvaṇa's arms. With his left arm he slew the demon hosts, with his right he saved the saints. ।।4।।
aarti.pad5: Gods, men and sages wave the āratī and proclaim: Glory, glory, glory to Hanumān! The camphor flame spreads over the golden platter as Mother Añjanā performs the āratī. ।।5।।
aarti.pad6: Whoever sings Hanumān's āratī dwells in Vaikuṇṭha and attains the supreme state. Śrī Rāma destroyed Laṅkā, and Tulasīdāsa sang the glory of his Lord. ।।6।।
